items.name: affiliation-metrics-py
items.description: Python 3 implementation of the affiliation metrics and tests for reproducing the experiments described in "Local Evaluation of Time Series Anomaly Detection Algorithms" [KDD 2022]

items.name: AI-ML-CV-NBA-Basketball-Analytics-System-Interface
items.description: A computer vision pipeline built with PyTorch for advanced NBA analytics. The system uses YOLO for player/ball detection, multi-object tracking, and a zero-shot classifier for team affiliation, and court key point detection to create a tactical top-down view and calculate real-world metrics like speed, distance, and passes.

items.name: Business_Health_Dashboard
items.description: An automated dashboard made in Google Sheets that tracks affiliation, conversion, ticket resolution, and virality metrics by cohort.

items.name: Decision-tree-implementation-from-scratch-
items.description: Decision Tree Classifier for Politician Party Prediction: Using voting records, this repo offers a Decision Tree model to predict party affiliation. Includes performance metrics and a learning curve for evaluation.

items.name: parkrun
items.description: As a parkrun noob, my aim was to gain an insight into the distribution of competitors across age and sex, and running club affiliation. Data cleansing using pandas. Visualizations using Seaborn. Customized functions to automate cleansing and report key metrics

items.name: co-authorship-computational-sociolinguistics
items.description: This notebook demonstrates how to process and analyse author data from a Web of Science (WoS) collection, with a focus on Computational Sociolinguistics. The goal is to prepare a clean author dataset with classifications, affiliations, and impact metrics that can later be used in a co-authorship network.

items.name: PDF-Parsing-and-2-mode-1-mode-network-visualization
items.description: The purpose of this research is to extract meeting minutes, currently captured in multiple PDF documents into a well-defined structured format in Microsoft Excel. Deploy visual networking techniques and network metrics to understand influencers and broadcasters and affiliation relationship, importance, strength, ties and interactions between members who have events in common on the network.

items.name: IS296-Data-Analysis-Project
items.description: Using Python's datascience library, the project entails the usage of tools given by datascience to analyze a researched topic and question chosen by the student. In this project, the aim was to find a correlative relationship between party affiliation per county in the United States and public health metric given by each county.
